author: gobernment
body:
A map that was made in spare time, this is a tournament map with TNT that is currently only 1.8 exclusive. This features two compact sides with lots of areas to navigate through, and two levels that you can fight from. The map was made by the names above, and I hope it offers fun gameplay. This is my first TM map I've worked on since Rendezvous 3.5, so hopefully off that it'll play good.

Special thanks to:
- Jiveh for placing a sign on it and hanging around
- alexanderjoe10 for hosting the server

If you have questions, feel free to post them below.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Just looking at the pictures I can see this was well thought out and planned in a lot of depth. It has two multi-functional layers for a range of cannons.
The only thing I'm concerned about is the size, if you've got a cannon firing 2 shots of tnt every 5 seconds, it's going to just wipe out the layers. Make it a lot bigger relatively to the damage of TNT, a lot farther apart so skybridges and Icarus' are still useable.

Apart from the size, great job! :D
